## Separation rule

A shared principal does not merge roles. Each assignment retains an independent scope, decision record, evidence obligation, and claim ceiling; no owner, identity, relation, lifecycle, or authority field is inferred from another.

## Claim ceiling

This prospective owner-registry postimage preserves sixteen decision-bound assignments and adds four separately scoped Craft identity roles only if the exact CML-07 semantic-foundation decision succeeds. Shared principal identity merges no authority.
